india6.description: The Congress alleged that Ms. Natarajan’s nomination was rejected as part of a “premeditated conspiracy” and all its 62 MLAs would call on President Droupadi Murmu in Delhi on Friday, June 12, to seek her intervention in the matter.

india6.title: Delhi High Court grants bail to Kashmir human-rights activist Khuram Parvez in UAPA case
india6.description: The court said the allegations against Khuram Parvez, though serious, were based on the statement of a co-accused-turned-approver, who claimed to be an NIA informer, and were yet to be tested in trial.

india6.title: Mirwaiz expresses concern over deadly violence in PoK, calls for dialogue
india6.description: “It is the responsibility of those in authority (in PoK) to listen, engage and peacefully resolve the matter, rather than allow it to escalate into violence, arbitrary arrests and loss of life,” said the Mirwaiz.

india6.title: It is only through Bharathiraja’s films that we can see what the villages of Tamil Nadu were once like: Actor Sivakumar
india6.description: “It was Bharathiraja who, for the first time, brought the villages of southern Tamil Nadu — especially those around Madurai — alive before our eyes”

india6.title: India summons U.S. Deputy Chief of Mission after second ship attack in three days
india6.description: “We condemn the attack on the commercial vessel Settebello off the coast of Oman,” the Ministry of External Affairs said in a statement.

india6.title: Two Indian seafarers dead, one missing after U.S. attack on ship off Oman, says sailors’ union
india6.description: India condemns attack, summons U.S. Embassy’s Deputy Chief of Mission Jason Meeks to lodge a “strong protest”

india6.title: Fresh hearing ordered on plea seeking FIR against Rahul over remarks on Hindu god Ram
india6.description: The petitioner accused Mr. Gandhi of referring to Lord Ram as a “mythological and fictional character” and stated that the comment deeply hurt the religious sentiments of Hindus and hence amounted to hate speech.

india6.title: Rahul meets Abhishek Banerjee amid push for INDIA bloc coordination
india6.description: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has also called for a meeting of his party colleagues on June 11; at June 8, the INDIA bloc met, and leaders called for better coordination and unity among partners

india6.title: PM Modi credits ‘public maturity’ for NDA’s 12-year stable rule
india6.description: Modi says ‘instability and turmoil’ before 2014 made the country ‘suffer immensely’, adding that govt. will make all efforts to fulfil the aspirations of youth, women, the middle class, and farmers

india7.title: Kuwait closes airspace amid ongoing Iranian attacks
india7.description: The announcement was made by Kuwait's Directorate General of Civil Aviation, which said flights were being diverted to alternative airports.

india7.title: Iran threatens to attack ships passing through Strait of Hormuz after fresh US strikes
india7.description: The US conducted strikes in Iran, threatening more if no peace deal is reached. Iran claimed counter-attacks and warned of Strait of Hormuz action, while US denied a closure and denied significant damage from Iranian strikes.

india7.title: New Delhi summons US envoy after strike on vessel off Oman leaves three Indians missing
india7.description: India summoned the US Charge d'Affaires to protest a US strike on the Palau-flagged tanker Settebello, leaving three Indian crew missing.

india7.title: EPFO 3.0 explained: UPI withdrawals, ATM access and simplified PF claims
india7.description: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation is launching EPFO 3.0, a digital upgrade for over seven crore subscribers. This platform will offer faster, simpler services, including UPI withdrawals and reduced paperwork, making provident fund access more accessible.

india7.title: US-Iran tensions flare as Trump orders strikes; Tehran hits American bases around Hormuz
india7.description: Iran's Revolutionary Guards attacked a Jordan base and Gulf targets in retaliation for US strikes. Jordan intercepted missiles, while Kuwait and Bahrain reported drone and missile attacks.

india7.title: Slowdown to rising inequality: Cost of Modi govt’s economic denial
india7.description: The Modi government exhibits persistent economic policy issues including ad hocism, data manipulation, and a denial of lived realities, failing to address slowdowns, investment declines, and rising inequality.

india7.title: H-1B fee struck down: What US court ruling means for Indians and Trump's immigration policy
india7.description: A US court struck down the Trump administration's $100,000 H-1B visa fee, ruling the executive branch lacked authority. This removes a significant financial barrier for Indian professionals and employers reliant on foreign talent, though the administration intends to appeal.

india7.title: Vizag Steel Plant explosion: 8 workers killed, 6 injured; PM announces ₹2 lakh exgratia
india7.description: An explosion at Vizag Steel Plant killed eight workers and injured six, with molten iron spillage triggering a fire. Investigations and compensation are underway.

india7.title: Iran, Israel halt hostilities after first attacks since truce
india7.description: Hostilities between Iran and Israel have reportedly ceased after an exchange of strikes, despite continued violence in southern Lebanon. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated the 'fire is contained', while Tehran announced a halt to its military action.

india7.title: Six Indians among eight killed in Dubai bus accident
india7.description: Eight people, including six Indians, died in a minibus crash on Dubai's Emirates Road when it hit a truck, with five of the eight injured remaining critical.

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz6月11日(木) 新技術IOWN 将来性と今後の焦点は
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 株価 荒い値動き 一時1800円以上 値下がりの場面も
japan1.description: 11日の東京株式市場、イラン情勢が再び悪化するとの懸念から、日経平均株価は一時、1800円以上値下がりしました。しかし、その後は、値下がりした銘柄を買い戻す動きも出て、荒い値動きとなっています。

japan1.title: NYダウ 950ドルを超える値下がり 5万ドルを割り込む
japan1.description: 10日のニューヨーク株式市場では、イラン情勢が再び悪化するとの懸念から幅広い銘柄に売り注文が出て、ダウ平均株価は950ドルを超える値下がりとなり、5万ドルを割り込みました。

japan1.title: NTT 次世代のIT技術 実用化や事業展開が課題に
japan1.description: NTTは、次世代のIT技術の普及に向け、国内外の企業が出資するファンドを設立し、世界の新興企業への投資を進めていくことを明らかにしました。海外の巨大企業との間で競争が激しくなる中、技術の実用化や事業展開を迅速に進められるかが課題となります。

japan1.title: トヨタ自動車 豊田章男会長の昨年度の役員報酬は21億円
japan1.description: トヨタ自動車は昨年度の役員報酬を公表し、豊田章男会長は21億1300万円で前の年度より8％増えました。トヨタの役員として過去最高の金額で、会社は、ほかの世界的な自動車メーカーのトップの水準を参考に見直したなどとしています。

japan1.title: ヨーロッパ中央銀行 2年9か月ぶり利上げか 11日の理事会で
japan1.description: ヨーロッパ中央銀行は金融政策を決める理事会で日本時間の11日夜、2年9か月ぶりの利上げに踏み切るという見方が強まっています。ヨーロッパではイラン情勢を受けてエネルギー価格の高騰が続いていて、物価のさらなる上振れへの警戒が背景にあるものとみられます。

japan1.title: 米スターバックスが日本事業の売却を含めて検討と報道
japan1.description: アメリカの大手コーヒーチェーン「スターバックス」が日本事業の売却などを検討していると、アメリカのメディアが報じました。日本事業を上場させることも選択肢の1つで、会社はまだ最終的な決定を下していないと伝えています。

japan1.title: 大手金融各社 米アンソロピック・NEC連携に参加の方針固める
japan1.description: 高性能なAIの登場でシステムのセキュリティー対策が課題となる中、国内の銀行、証券、保険の大手各社が、アメリカの新興AI企業、アンソロピックとNECが作る連携の枠組みに参加する方針を固めました。セキュリティー対策や金融サービスの高度化などで協業を進める見通しです。

japan1.title: 日銀植田総裁が入院 来週の金融政策決定会合は欠席の見込み
japan1.description: 日銀は、植田総裁が感染症のため9日から入院していて、入院期間は2週間程度の見込みだと発表しました。来週15日、16日に金融政策決定会合を控えていますが植田総裁は欠席する見込みです。植田総裁は書面で意見を表明し、会合では議長を氷見野副総裁が、記者会見は内田副総裁が代理するとしています。植田総裁は、入院中はリモートワークで公務を続けるということです。

japan1.title: 5月企業物価指数 前年同月比6.3％上昇 中東情勢で上昇幅拡大
japan1.description: 企業の間で取り引きされるモノの価格を示す5月の企業物価指数は、去年の同じ月と比べて6.3％上昇しました。中東情勢の影響で石油関連製品の取引価格が値上がりしていることが要因で、上昇幅は2023年3月以来の大きさとなりました。

japan1.title: 円相場 小幅な値動きも 1ドル＝160円台での取り引き続く
japan1.description: 10日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は小幅な値動きでしたが、1ドル＝160円台での取り引きが続きました。

japan1.title: NTT 次世代技術「IOWN」普及へファンド設立 AI新興企業に投資
japan1.description: NTTは、次世代のIT技術「IOWN」を国際的に普及させるため、国内外のおよそ20の企業が出資する新たなファンドを設立すると発表しました。日本と、アメリカのシリコンバレーに拠点を置き、AIや半導体など関連する技術の開発を手がける新興企業に投資する方針です。

japan1.title: ガソリン全国平均169.5円 政府補助金で170円水準続く
japan1.description: 国の委託を受けてガソリン価格を調査している石油情報センターによりますと、レギュラーガソリンの小売価格は、8日時点の全国平均で1リットルあたり169.5円となり、前の週と同じでした。政府の激変緩和措置による補助金で170円程度の水準が続いています。また、11日からの出荷分を対象とした補助金の額は、前の週より6.3円減って1リットルあたり27円になるとしています。

japan1.title: 株価 一時1600円超下落 イラン情勢めぐる懸念など背景
japan1.description: 10日の東京株式市場、アメリカとイラン双方の攻撃を受けて、イラン情勢の先行きへの懸念が強まったことなどから、半導体関連の銘柄を中心に売り注文が広がり、日経平均株価は一時、1600円を超える値下がりとなりました。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz6月10日(水) アメリカメディア 明暗分けるのは
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 米アンソロピック ミュトス級AIを一般提供開始 安全対策加えて
japan1.description: アメリカのAI新興企業「アンソロピック」は9日、高性能なAIモデル「クロード・ミュトス」と同等のモデルについて、一般の顧客向けに提供を始めたと発表しました。「ミュトス」についてはサイバー攻撃に悪用されるおそれがあるとしてこれまで一般への提供は見送ってきましたが、悪用される可能性がある指示には直接答えないなどの対策を加えたとしています。

japan1.title: 経団連会長 “対中 新ビジネス枯渇に懸念” 関係改善探る
japan1.description: 経団連の筒井会長は、いわゆる「台湾有事」をめぐる国会答弁をきっかけに悪化した日中関係について「中国との新しいビジネスの話が枯渇しかけていることに懸念を強く持っている」と述べ、経済界としても関係の改善を目指して中国側との対話の糸口を探っていきたいという考えを示しました。

japan1.title: ひぼう中傷などの投稿削除 SNS事業者によってばらつき
japan1.description: インターネット上のひぼう中傷などの投稿について、SNSを運営する事業者の対応状況が公表されました。利用者からの申し出を受けて削除を行った件数は事業者によってばらつきがあり、専門家は改善点などを検討すべきだとしています。

japan1.title: JR東日本 来春に磁気付き切符を廃止しQRコードの切符に
japan1.description: JR東日本は、今使われている磁気付きの切符について、来年春に、QRコードが記載された切符に切り替えると発表しました。

japan1.title: 円相場 1ドル＝160円台の前半で小幅な値動き
japan1.description: 9日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は1ドル＝160円台の前半での値動きになりました。

japan1.title: 中東情勢 エアコン取り付けや酪農用資材に影響 調達に懸念の声
japan1.description: 中東情勢の日本国内への経済影響が続いています。福岡市の家電販売店ではエアコンの注文を受けてから取り付け工事を行うまで1か月ほど顧客に待ってもらう対応をとっています。また熊本県内の酪農家からは、飼料となる牧草の保存に欠かせないポリエチレン製のフィルムの確保などで先行きを懸念する声が上がっています。

japan1.title: “ナフサ由来製品 足りていると発信続けること大事” 経産相
japan1.description: 「ナフサ」に由来する化学製品などで流通の「目詰まり」が指摘されていることに関して、赤澤経済産業大臣は9日の閣議のあとの会見で「大事なのは、量は足りていると発信を続けることだ」と述べ、関係業界と連携しながら問題の解消に取り組む考えを示しました。

japan1.title: 日銀 “政策金利１％程度へ” 来週の会合で利上げを最終判断へ
japan1.description: 日銀は来週15日から開く金融政策決定会合で利上げの実施を最終判断することにしています。イラン情勢の悪化で原油高や円安傾向が続く中、この先、物価が大幅に上昇するリスクに対応する必要があるとして、政策金利を1％程度に引き上げる方向で議論する方針です。

japan1.title: 株価 終値はきのうと比べて1300円以上値上がり
japan1.description: 9日の東京株式市場、半導体関連の銘柄を中心に買い注文が広がり、日経平均株価は8日より1300円以上値上がりしました。

japan1.title: 自民 積極財政議連が提言 “消費税率ゼロ 必ず実現を”
japan1.description: ことし夏の「骨太の方針」に向けて、自民党の議員連盟は物価高から国民生活を守るため、食料品の消費税率を必ずゼロにすることなどを求める提言を城内成長戦略担当大臣に手渡しました。

japan1.title: 中国 5月の輸出額 19％余り増加 原油高の影響が今後の焦点
japan1.description: 中国の5月の輸出額は、東南アジア向けが大きく伸び、アメリカ向けも大幅に増加したことから、去年の同じ月と比べて19％余り増えました。今後はイラン情勢を背景とした原油価格の高止まりがどう影響するかが焦点となります。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz 6月9日(火) 日本の往年の名曲が世界でヒット!
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 国交省に石油製品の相談9500件 うち850件の状況特定し解消へ
japan1.description: 国土交通省は、イラン情勢に伴う石油関連製品の供給の偏りや「目詰まり」に関して、自動車整備や住宅などの分野で9500件の相談が寄せられ、このうち850件について状況を特定し、解消に向けて取り組んでいると明らかにしました。

japan1.title: オープンAI 新規株式公開を申請 評価額は3月末時点で約136兆円
japan1.description: 生成AI「ChatGPT」の開発を手がけるアメリカの「オープンAI」は、証券取引委員会に対し、IPO＝新規株式公開の申請を非公開で行ったことを明らかにしました。この企業の評価額はことし3月末時点でおよそ136兆円に達したとされ、生成AIの急速な普及をけん引した注目企業の上場に市場の関心が高まっています。

japan1.title: 赤澤経産相“原発建て替えへ立地自治体などの理解求めていく”
japan1.description: 赤澤経済産業大臣は9日の閣議のあとの会見で、2040年代までに最大で5基の原子力発電所を建て替える必要があるとする見通しについて、「エネルギー安全保障に寄与し、原子力人材の強化を図るために重要だ」と述べ、国が前面に立って立地する自治体などの理解を求めていく考えを示しました。

japan2.title: In aging South Korea, AI dolls are caring for the elderly
japan2.description: Authorities are providing AI care devices to seniors living alone, including in districts of Seoul and in Yongin, south of the capital.

japan2.title: Manga on North Korean abductions published amid little progress over issue
japan2.description: The work, which mixes fiction with facts and actual tactics used by North Korea to kidnap Japanese nationals, seeks to draw attention to the decades-old issue.

japan2.title: India turns to military to beef up security after exam scandals
japan2.description: The government will deploy the Indian Air Force for the first time ever to transport question papers, according to officials familiar with the matter

japan2.title: Teenagers in Tokyo allegedly used ChatGPT to decide extortion amount in assault case
japan2.description: Five teenagers were arrested in January over the alleged assault and attempted extortion of ¥150,000 from a high school student in the city of Hachioji.

japan2.title: The fighting words fueling support for Japan’s World Cup team
japan2.description: Learn how Japanese expresses support, perseverance and encouragement through World Cup vocabulary and everyday phrases.

japan2.title: Japanese sports terms you may hear on TV
japan2.description: Like in other countries, Japanese announcers are filled with colorful terms to describe what you're seeing on air.

japan2.title: U.S. and Iran exchange attacks as Trump threatens further escalation
japan2.description: The attacks are the latest development in an exchange of strikes that threaten to reignite a full-scale war, which was paused in April when the two sides agreed to a ceasefire.

japan2.title: Russia’s conscripts recount pressure to fight in Ukraine
japan2.description: The country has hardened its once-avoidable conscription system, and once inside the military machine, draftees are pressured to sign contracts to fight in Ukraine.

japan2.title: Thai court to rule in long-delayed Bangkok bombing case
japan2.description: Two Uyghur men stand accused of planting a bomb at a Hindu shrine in Bangkok's commercial heart in August 2015. The defendants have denied the charges.

japan2.title: Oil surges as fresh U.S. strikes on Iran threaten fragile truce
japan2.description: Brent crude surged over 2% to trade above $95 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate advanced toward $93, before paring gains after the U.S. ended a brief campaign of strikes.

japan2.title: Pilots demand answers ahead of Air India crash anniversary
japan2.description: India's Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau is expected to only issue an interim report — frustrating those awaiting clear answers about why their relatives died.

japan2.title: North Korea will ‘never’ get nuclear recognition, EU and South Korea say
japan2.description: The announcement comes after Chinese leader Xi Jinping skipped any public mention of denuclearization on the Korean Peninsula during his visit to Pyongyang this week.

japan2.title: In Japan, Nepali students navigate a growing study-to-work pathway
japan2.description: A growing stream of young people see the country less as a traditional study destination and more as a structured route into work and long-term opportunity.

japan2.title: Osaka police arrest 41 over alleged side-job scam affecting 2,300 people
japan2.description: In the scam posted on social media, victims were told they could earn large sums through a side job if they first paid for training courses.

japan2.title: White House defends Cuba sanctions as U.N. warns of harm
japan2.description: U.N. ⁠High Commissioner for ​Human Rights Volker Turk said the measures were affecting the Cuban population's human rights, especially ​access to ‌essential supplies and services.

japan2.title: Injured Takumi Minamino takes on role of mentor for Japan at World Cup
japan2.description: The Japanese ​international ruptured the anterior cruciate ligament in his left knee while playing for AS Monaco in December

japan2.title: Gianni Infantino defends FIFA over visa issues in U.S. ahead of World Cup
japan2.description: Infantino said FIFA ⁠understands there are also times to "chill and relax" when visa issues arise rather than creating additional conflict.

japan2.title: Taiwan says sovereignty cannot be ‘violated,’ as China ends patrol
japan2.description: "Any country ​that asserts jurisdiction will be expelled without exception," Taiwan's ​coast ​guard said in a statement.

japan2.title: With Pope Leo’s blessing, Barcelona’s Sagrada Familia reaches new heights
japan2.description: The pontiff said the fact the basilica is yet unfinished does not mar its beauty but rather serves to remind believers "that ‌the Christian life is always a journey."

japan2.title: Japan’s retail investor army flocks to SpaceX after IPO drought
japan2.description: SpaceX's blockbuster IPO is drawing intense retail demand in Japan, where cash-rich households see a rare shot at a marquee global listing tied to Elon Musk and the space boom.

japan2.title: Canada moves to ban social media for children under 16 and regulate AI chatbots
japan2.description: Companies could face penalties of 3% ​of global revenue or up to C$10 million ($7.2 million), whichever is more, for failing to comply.

japan2.title: ’Filter of fantasy’: Psychiatrist trials anime therapy for depression
japan2.description: Francesco Panto's team gave participants online counseling delivered by a psychologist who appeared on the screen as an anime avatar with a digitally altered voice.

japan2.title: China lures foreign patients with cutting-edge, cheap medical care
japan2.description: While traditional medical tourism hotspots such as Thailand and South Korea focus on services like cosmetic surgery, China is differentiating itself with advanced procedures.

japan2.title: Northern Irish police use water cannon on second night of protests
japan2.description: Restaurants and businesses shuttered in the center of Belfast, schools closed and public transport shut down amid fears of a repeat of Tuesday night's riots.

japan2.title: Trump and Modi likely to have first meeting since Pakistan spat
japan2.description: Despite personal ties between leaders and similar strategic priorities, relations between the U.S. and India have soured over India's clashes with Pakistan and trade tensions.

japan2.title: Bill Gates tells Congress his Epstein ties were ‘grave error’
japan2.description: The release of Justice Department files on Jeffrey Epstein has spurred close public scrutiny of the convicted sex offender's past associations with powerful figures.

japan2.title: Stock investors eye deep run for Japan at World Cup
japan2.description: A deep run for Japan at the most lucrative FIFA World Cup in history could benefit companies including Dentsu, Konami and Hub.

japan2.title: Former Lower House speaker Yohei Kono dies at 89
japan2.description: Kono was a leading dove within the ruling Liberal Democratic Party and championed stable ties with neighbors of Japan, including China and South Korea.

japan2.title: Two Matsuya companies team up in Tokyo on premium beef dishes
japan2.description: The Matsuya Premium Ginza store offers upscale takeout dishes including premium beef-on-rice bowls.

japan2.title: Canada to join Japan-Italy-U.K. fighter project as observer
japan2.description: A observer country will be able to access sensitive information, such as progress in the fighter project.

china1.description: Beijing's Beihai Park is in the midst of a vibrant spring.

china1.title: Service sector powers China's new engine of economic growth
china1.description: The service sector in China not only holds vast consumption potential as a daily necessity but also generates powerful productive forces.

china1.title: Iran conflict, regulations spike gas prices in California
china1.description: Iran conflict, regulations spike gas prices in California

china1.title: Beijing in full bloom as spring comes early
china1.description: Beijing has entered spring ahead of its usual schedule with parks across the city turning into living postcards. From Beihai to Zizhuyuan, cherry blossoms, plum flowers and more are unfolding one after another. If there's ever a moment to step outside, this is it.

china1.title: Gulf oil exporters seek alternative routes amid Hormuz disruptions
china1.description: The ongoing conflict involving the United States, Israel and Iran has disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz for over a month, prompting major Gulf oil producers to accelerate efforts to secure alternative export routes.

china1.title: China's factory-gate prices rise in March, ending 3-year slide
china1.description: China's producer price index (PPI) rose by 1.0% month-on-month and 0.5% year-on-year in March.

china1.title: Regional institute: China key supply hub in ASEAN+3 production network

bd3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bd3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bd3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bd3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bd3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bd3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bd3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bd3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bd3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bd3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bd3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bd3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bd3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bd3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bd3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bd3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
bd3.description: The BNP yesterday skipped Election Commission’s dialogue seeking recommendations of political parties on how to hold a free and fair general election.
